items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: But since Harold Batiste and Alice Marcel has returned to the city and put this jazz programs on the UNO and so forth, so they have found some of the cream of the crop of young musicians

ctx.x: I don't see any clarinet players.

Again we get back, I haven't said anything about this but there is that element of musicians who learn and educate themselves and there's that element of young musicians now who go out to have a good time. And they learn up to a certain amount and that's it. They are not enough. And maybe, maybe, maybe, maybe I'm wrong about saying this but as up until five years or six years ago there wasn't enough serious musicians in this city, young musicians. But since Harold Batiste and Alice Marcel has returned to the city…
And have a real professional attitude about it.
